name: mobile-platform
description: TypeScript platform template for shipping React Native (Expo) apps with a NestJS API to AWS serverless.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @platform/spec-test && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @platform/spec-test && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @platform/spec-test && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
